T:P1.1.text: Specialized Care for Women, Babies and Children | Pediatrix & Obstetrix

T:P1.2.text: Led by physicians and trusted by patients, Pediatrix delivers advanced medical solutions across a variety of practice areas around the country.

T:P1.3.text: Specialized Care for Women, Babies and Children

T:P1.4.text: Led by physicians. Trusted by patients. We deliver advanced medical solutions nationwide, in-person and virtually.

T:P1.5.text: Be part of a nationwide team of physicians, advanced practitioners, and operational experts all working to support families and advance patient care.

T:P1.6.text: We are one of the nation's largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.

T:P1.7.text: We operate in 37 states, partner with nearly 400 hospitals, and work with 4,300+ affiliated clinicians.

T:P1.8.text: We bring more than 45 years of experience to help hospitals respond to shifting demands with flexible, patient-centered care strategies.

T:P1.9.text: We invest in clinical services, operations, technology, and education—giving our clinicians the tools, resources, and support they need to deliver exceptional patient care.

T:P1.10.text: Our Center for Research, Education, Quality and Safety is dedicated to advancing care through evidence-based medicine.

T:P1.11.text: Access accredited continuing education—available both live and on demand.

T:P1.12.text: Founded and led by physicians, we understand the importance of a supportive environment. Find your place with us.

T:P1.13.text: Hear from leading experts in neonatology as they explore the latest advances and critical issues in the field.

T:P1.14.text: Support for women’s health, pregnancy and high-risk care

T:P1.15.text: Highly specialized care for newborn babies

T:P1.16.text: Specialty and critical care for children

T:P2.2.text: Our physician-led health care organization partners with hospitals and health care facilities to offer clinical services from birth through adulthood

T:P2.4.text: A network of experienced clinical specialists at your service

T:P2.5.text: Our physician-led health care organization partners with hospitals, health systems and health care facilities to offer clinical services. Together we make a difference in the lives of our patients and their families.

T:P2.6.text: Meet the leaders who provide differentiated value to our partners while guiding us on our mission to Take great care of the patient.®

T:P2.7.text: Customized solutions to meet your hospital's changing needs.

T:P2.8.text: Our Government Relations team collaborates with physician groups, professional societies and hospital partners to promote our public policy efforts.

T:P2.9.text: Experienced clinical specialists trusted by patients, hospitals and referring physicians to Take great care of the patient. ®

T:P2.10.text: Our skilled clinicians collaborate with health care partners and providers to develop customized solutions that benefit hospitals, patients and payors through:

T:P2.11.text: Optimizing clinical, financial and operational performance

T:P2.12.text: Improving patient care and the total patient experience

T:P2.13.text: Using advanced clinical tools, quality initiatives, training and robust data and research to optimize care quality and performance

T:P2.14.text: Our integrated network of solutions helps develop customized solutions for affordable, higher-quality care.

T:P3.2.text: Led by physicians and trusted by patients, Pediatrix offers extensive services that work together across the women’s, babies’ and children’s continuum of care.
